name: Block Party Boss
text: When Block Party Boss enters, your other **Crew** cards get +1 to every stat this turn.
flavor: Everybody knows whose party it is.

name: Corner Lookout
text: **Alert.** At the start of your turn, look at the top card of any deck.

name: Night Shift
text: Draw two cards. If you played a **Crew** card this turn, draw three instead.
flavor: The city never sleeps. Neither do you.

name: Mixtape Drop
text: Gain $2. The next **Crew** card you play this turn costs $1 less.

name: Corner Store
text: At the start of your turn: gain $1.
